title: Token introspection calls each emit one structured audit event on the fixed allow-list
asA: operator running the runtime-verify suite against the introspection client
iWant: every introspect call to write one structured `keycloak.introspection` event carrying only the allow-list fields
soThat: the audit stream stays free of the introspection response body and every refusal carries a stable reasonClass

acceptanceCriteria.description: An introspect call whose response is `active: true` emits exactly one `keycloak.introspection` event carrying `outcome=verified` and the caller's realm slug.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a token whose introspection endpoint response is a `200 { active: true, ... }` against realm `alpha`
acceptanceCriteria.when: the introspection client introspects the token
acceptanceCriteria.then: the audit sink records exactly one event whose own-property keys are exactly `{family, outcome, realmSlug, at}` with `family=keycloak.introspection` and `outcome=verified`; the introspection response body, the token value, the client secret, and any substring of the above are not present in any field

acceptanceCriteria.description: An introspect call whose response is a 2xx `active: false` emits exactly one `keycloak.introspection` audit event with `outcome=refused` and `reasonClass=inactive`.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a token whose introspection endpoint response is a 2xx `{ active: false }` against realm `alpha`
acceptanceCriteria.when: the introspection client introspects the token
acceptanceCriteria.then: the audit sink records exactly one event whose own-property keys are exactly `{family, outcome, reasonClass, realmSlug, at}` with `family=keycloak.introspection`, `outcome=refused`, and `reasonClass=inactive`; the introspection response body is not present in any field

acceptanceCriteria.description: A transient introspection failure followed by a successful retry emits exactly one refused event with `reasonClass=upstream_error` and one verified event on the `keycloak.introspection` family, in order; the retry itself is not a distinct event.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a token whose introspection endpoint returns 503 on the first attempt and 200 with `active: true` on the second
acceptanceCriteria.when: the introspection client retries per its documented posture and completes the call
acceptanceCriteria.then: the audit sink records exactly two events in order: one `keycloak.introspection` event with `outcome=refused` and `reasonClass=upstream_error`, then one `keycloak.introspection` event with `outcome=verified`; no additional event is written for the retry itself

acceptanceCriteria.description: A sink failure during the emission of a `keycloak.introspection` event does not mask the underlying introspection outcome; the mechanism records a `keycloak.audit_sink_failed` warning event and the introspection outcome is unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria.given: an introspect call whose response is `active: true` and an audit sink whose write throws
acceptanceCriteria.when: the introspection client emits the completion event
acceptanceCriteria.then: the client's return value still reports the underlying introspection result unchanged; the mechanism records a `keycloak.audit_sink_failed` warning event carrying the realm slug and a reason-class string; the introspection response body does not appear

acceptanceCriteria.description: An introspect call whose response is a non-2xx status emits exactly one `keycloak.introspection` audit event with `outcome=refused` and `reasonClass=upstream_error`.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a token whose introspection endpoint responds with a 5xx status against realm `alpha`
acceptanceCriteria.when: the introspection client introspects the token
acceptanceCriteria.then: the audit sink records exactly one event whose own-property keys are exactly `{family, outcome, reasonClass, realmSlug, at}` with `family=keycloak.introspection`, `outcome=refused`, and `reasonClass=upstream_error`; the introspection response body is not present in any field

acceptanceCriteria.description: Introspecting the same active token twice is idempotent: each introspect call emits exactly one `keycloak.introspection` audit event with `outcome=verified`; two consecutive introspect calls produce two events (count is one per introspect call, whether the second call is served from the introspection cache or not).
acceptanceCriteria.given: a token whose introspection endpoint response is a 2xx `{ active: true }` on both attempts, and one completed introspect call already on record
acceptanceCriteria.when: the introspection client introspects the same token a second time
acceptanceCriteria.then: the audit sink records exactly one additional event whose own-property keys are exactly `{family, outcome, realmSlug, at}` with `family=keycloak.introspection` and `outcome=verified`; the total count of `keycloak.introspection` verified events across the two calls is exactly two; the caller's return value is unchanged between the two calls

acceptanceCriteria.description: An introspect call whose introspection endpoint responds with `401 Unauthorized` to the mechanism's client credentials (the client is authenticated but not authorised to call introspection on this realm; the credential lacks the required permission scope) emits exactly one `keycloak.introspection` event with `outcome=refused` and `reasonClass=client_forbidden`; the introspection response body does not appear.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a realm-config record for `alpha` whose introspection endpoint responds `401 Unauthorized` to the configured `clientId`
acceptanceCriteria.when: the introspection client introspects any token against realm `alpha`
acceptanceCriteria.then: the audit sink records exactly one event whose own-property keys are exactly `{family, outcome, reasonClass, realmSlug, at}` with `family=keycloak.introspection`, `outcome=refused`, and `reasonClass=client_forbidden`; the introspection response body is not present in any field; no client secret appears

description: Applying agent sets: no project-parameterised values on this story; every AC is `fixed`. AC-set sufficiency (7a inline note per blueprint-authoring.md §7a): the credential scenario class is bound by AC-1 (a 2xx `{ active: true }` introspection response is the credential and the event records the realm-scoped identity via the `realmSlug` payload field). The permission scenario class is bound by AC-7 (an introspect call whose upstream returns `401 Unauthorized` names a valid client credential lacking the required permission scope on this realm and is refused with `reasonClass=client_forbidden`).
